entities.summary: Georgina Oliva Isern is a Spanish field hockey midfielder who competed at the 2008 and 2016 Summer Olympics. She was included to the national team in 2006, and in 2015 named Best Player at the Valencia semifinal of the 2014/15 World League and Best Player in the Spanish Division de Honor. Individual award : Player of the Tournament in 2019 Women's EuroHockey Nations Championship ....
